role: Human documentation for scripts/: describes selected CI/quality scripts and the add_swift_file.py pbxproj helper.
toplevel: Markdown only; no executable content. Sections are recorded as doc-section units.

flags.text: README lists add_swift_file.py supported folders without Emuqu/Sources/Views/MorningResults and Views/Utilities (the script docstring lists them; they resolve via the basename regex fallback, not the explicit map), and its Troubleshooting says paths must start with Emuqu/Sources/ although EmuquTests paths are supported.

units.does: no behavioural claim: title 'Scripts' and one-line intro.
no behavioural claim: heading grouping the quality/CI script descriptions.

Claims select_simulator_destination.sh selects the first usable iOS Simulator destination for the Emuqu scheme; run_tests_with_coverage.sh calls it with SCHEME and PROJECT when DESTINATION is unset (run_tests_with_coverage.sh:54). The script has no listed units.

Claims run_tests_with_coverage.sh runs tests with coverage and evaluates the coverage gate, with env defaults SCHEME=Emuqu, PROJECT=Emuqu.xcodeproj, RESULT_BUNDLE=build/TestResults.xcresult, MIN_COVERAGE optional override (committed .ci floors otherwise), DESTINATION override, MAX_TEST_WORKERS=3. Verified: run_tests_with_coverage.sh:6-9,77 set those defaults and lines 304-308 call check_coverage.sh with or without MIN_COVERAGE.
Claims check_coverage.sh checks app line coverage from an .xcresult and fails below threshold. Code enforces three floors (overall, logic ex-Views, Views-only), not one.

Claims check_budget_monotonicity.sh fails any diff that raises a value in .ci/*.txt unless a `budget-raise-ok: .ci/<file>.txt <why>` trailer exists, and needs fetch-depth 0. Code also treats min_* files as floors (decrease fails) and skips non-integer files.

flags.text: README says any raise of a value in .ci/*.txt fails; non-integer files are skipped, so .ci/min_coverage_views.txt (43.5) can be changed freely, and deleting a budget file is never compared.

units.does: Claims check_uitest_fresh_install.sh requires every UI-test suite to launch with -UITests-FreshInstall (via the UITestLaunch harness). Script outside this chunk confirms the grep at check_uitest_fresh_install.sh:53; it has no listed units.
Claims check_test_skip_budget.sh counts XCTSkip/XCTSkipUnless call sites against .ci/test_skip_budget.txt and ratchets toward zero.

Claims check_localization_bundle.sh requires every String(localized:)/NSLocalizedString to name LanguageManager.appBundle. The script only requires some `bundle:` argument inside the call (check_localization_bundle.sh:71,132).

flags.text: README says the bundle must be LanguageManager.appBundle; the gate accepts any `bundle:` argument.

units.does: Claims check_fixed_font_budget.sh counts raw .font(.system(size:)) in the view layer against .ci/fixed_font_budget.txt. Code counts only numeric-literal sizes across all of Emuqu/ (not only views) and also enforces a separate watch budget.

flags.text: README says the gate counts raw .font(.system(size:)) 'in the view layer'; the script scans all of Emuqu/ (SOURCE_ROOT default 'Emuqu', including EmuquApp.swift) plus a separate watch budget, and counts only numeric-literal sizes.

units.does: Claims check_strict_concurrency_enabled.sh proves Swift 6 mode, SWIFT_STRICT_CONCURRENCY = complete and warnings-as-errors in every configuration. Script greps SWIFT_VERSION/SWIFT_STRICT_CONCURRENCY/SWIFT_TREAT_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS counts (check_strict_concurrency_enabled.sh:32-35).

Claims check_thread_sanitizer.sh runs the unit suite under TSan, fails on any race, is its own CI job and is not in `make ci`. Makefile ci target (Makefile:272) indeed omits thread-sanitizer; ci.yml runs it only when scope != gates. Script has no listed units.
Claims remove_swift_file.py strips the four pbxproj entries for a file and deletes it from disk with --delete. remove_swift_file.py:83-104 parses --delete.
Claims install-git-hooks.sh configures repository-local hooks (.githooks). Script sets `git config core.hooksPath .githooks`; no listed units.
Claims add_swift_file.py adds a new Swift file to Emuqu.xcodeproj.
Claims the script creates PBXFileReference, PBXBuildFile, PBXGroup child and PBXSourcesBuildPhase entries. Matches add_file_to_project.
Claims usage `python3 scripts/add_swift_file.py <relative_path_to_swift_file>`; main enforces exactly one argument.
Examples adding files to Collection, Models, Views; all three folders are in the explicit group map.
Lists supported folder paths. The explicit map covers them; README omits Views/MorningResults and Views/Utilities (resolved by regex fallback) and EmuquUITests (target mapped but no group id).

flags.text: Folder list differs from the script's docstring (which adds Views/MorningResults and Views/Utilities) and from the explicit path_to_group map.

units.does: Claims: unique IDs avoiding collisions, file reference, build file, group assignment by folder path, and Sources build phase entry. Code matches; the Sources phase is resolved per target via target_for_path/find_sources_build_phase_id.

flags.text: README (and the docstring) says generated IDs are 'unique hexadecimal IDs'; generate_unique_id builds them from prefixes A1/EF/UC/P2/CK/RF/OB, so most contain non-hex letters (U, P, K, R, O).

units.does: Claims the file need not exist (main only warns), .swift suffix is validated, and a group error means the path is not in the supported list. Matches main.

Troubleshooting: 'Could not find group for path' and 'Could not find project file' error messages exist in add_file_to_project and main. Says paths must start with Emuqu/Sources/ although EmuquTests paths are supported.
Claims the script only modifies project.pbxproj, generates unique IDs, does not delete or modify existing entries, and can be safely re-run.

flags.text: 'Can be safely re-run' is false: add_file_to_project never checks whether the file is already registered, so a re-run inserts duplicate PBXFileReference/PBXBuildFile/Sources rows ('Multiple commands produce').
